text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold winning positions, especially Stock D, to lock in gains; I should base sell decisions on the portfolio’s risk and outlook, not the satisfaction of realizing a profit.","I made large purchases in periods 7 and 8, including after sharp price moves, then held through a decline and recovery. Since past moves do not predict future returns, I should avoid treating recent prices or my average cost as signals.","A few winning trades or a short-term account-value rebound do not establish that my strategy is working. I should monitor diversification and total portfolio risk, not judge each stock as a separate account."]}
